request.style: English, female solo voice with ethereal choir, Celtic harp, tin whistle, bodhran, fiddle, ambient pads, contemplative and majestic mood, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
On the last and greatest day of the festival
Jesus stood up and cried out to the crowd
He called to every soul that was weary
To come to him and drink from the source

[Chorus]
If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me
And drink from the well that never runs dry
Whoever believes in me, as Scripture said
Out of his heart shall flow rivers of living water

[Verse]
You will look for me and will not find me
Where I am you cannot come, they said
But the promise breaks the silence now
The Spirit waits to be given to the faithful

[Chorus]
If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me
And drink from the well that never runs dry
Whoever believes in me, as Scripture said
Out of his heart shall flow rivers of living water

[Bridge]
Some said this really is the Prophet
Others claimed he is the Christ indeed
But the Spirit had not yet been given
Waiting for the glory yet to come

[Chorus]
If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me
And drink from the well that never runs dry
Whoever believes in me, as Scripture said
Out of his heart shall flow rivers of living water

[Outro]
Rivers of living water
Flowing from the heart
